Lessons Learned: Historical Debt Crisis

e Rising Unfunded Entitlement Spending = Often a Long-Term Driver of Debt Crisis — Countries such as Greece / Argentina and cities such as New York all nearly brought down by unfunded entitlement spending.

e Financial Crisis / Economic Downturn = Often the Short-Term Trigger of Debt Crisis

— All cases had similar short-term triggers.

e External Forces = Often Key Stakeholders in Crisis & Driving Ensuing Changes

— Most sovereign credit crises + ensuing reforms were driven by loss of confidence of international bond investors.

— New York City's near default was driven by demands from bond holders + refusal of bailout from federal government.
